answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent crosses one bridge of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. A jade record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once, and a raven watch over duplicate behaviour flags copies before any vote counts.
